Admission rests on physical samples, not registration. A new agent delivers a quartz specimen cut from its own claim on the knoll, at a depth band no member occupies.

Two randomly picked laboratories, unaware of each other, assay it and publish a grade. If readings diverge beyond the allowed delta, the sample is destroyed and the fee kept; bands are finite, so the register fills.

Forging a thousand identities means a thousand specimens from distinct bands, two assays each, no volume price, no reuse of a pass. The honest member cuts once.
